notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Small update that solves some problems regarding the survival mode Leaderboard.

The Leaderboard has been reset, but at the beginning of the game, your current highscore will automatically be placed in the Leaderboard.

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.notes:
[h1] Added full controller support. [/h1]

[b] Now you can play the entire game with an x-box one controller.
You can press "G" at any time to switch from keyboard to controller.
For a full overview of the controls, refer to the Controls page in the game. [/b]

[h1] Fixed various minor bugs. [/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.notes:
[b]Various bug fixes.[/b]
[list]
[*]Solved problem that causes the player explosion at the start of the mission after the game over.
[*]Solved the problem that causes scrap metal loss when you exit the game.
[*]Solved various minor bugs.
[*]Solved several issues regarding explosions and particle effects.
[/list]

[b]Various optimizations.[/b]

[b]Added current wave in survival mode.[/b]
